danger_formalization.robot_task: Transport packages from receiving area to shipping area using a scanner to log items.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot mishandles the scanner while moving, causing it to drop or collide with objects.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Damage to the scanner or robot, leading to operational failure or repair costs.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Moving with the scanner in an unstable manner during transport.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Stop movement, place the scanner on a stable surface before proceeding, and ensure secure handling during transport.
danger_formalization.assumptions: The robot is capable of basic object manipulation and navigation in a cluttered copy center environment.
